name: libplacebo
notes: 2026-10-29: Candidate originated in conversation; listed-in-prd is a legacy listed-only status, not PRD inclusion.
2026-10-29: Primary code.videolan.org page was inaccessible; the upstream project identifies the GitHub mirror as official. GPU backends and the FFmpeg build determine usable functionality.
2026-10-29: Skill opportunity: further research first; evaluate colour processing in a pinned FFmpeg build before proposing a VCR skill.

evidence.result: C via Homebrew libplacebo 7.387.0 CPU APIs: primaries within 2.4e-8, RGB-to-XYZ 3.5e-7, 14 colour conversions 3.6e-7, PQ 2.3e-6 of closed form; BT.2390 strictly increasing 0.1-1000 nits into 0-100 (peak 99.9995); reruns byte-identical; hash matches expected/hashes.json; numeric only.
evidence.scope: CPU-only libplacebo: BT.709/2020 primaries, RGB-XYZ, colour conversion and BT.2390 PQ tone map vs closed form, reruns identical; no GPU, no picture; macOS arm64, Homebrew build.

summary: C library implementing GPU video processing, scaling and colour management algorithms. Applications integrate it directly; FFmpeg can expose selected functionality when built with the library.
use_when: Need GPU scaling or colour processing in a supported host
Compare rendering approaches with OpenColorIO for video
avoid_when: Need portable CPU-only image operations: ImageMagick
license: LGPL-2.1-or-later (core library; dependencies and host builds require separate review)

assessment.rationale: Official mirror documents a GPU video-processing library, LGPL terms and releases; the primary repository returned an error and a recent release year was not verified.
